title: Prosecution: New voting rule doesn't ease burden of proof in impeachment

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court’s updated voting formula does not make the evidence against Vice President Sara Z. Duterte stronger or relieve the House prosecution panel of its burden of proof, prosecutors said Thursday. House lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville “Jinky Bitrics” Luistro said the revised denominator affects both sides of the final vote during the trial. “What is lowered is not only the number for conviction but also the number for acquittal,” Luistro said during a press conference. “That has a two-way consequence.” READ: Consistent, Luistro says of OVP after COA flags its transactions anew “Yes, the […]...
